reason: The hypothesis relies on grain-boundary-mediated oxidation, but the cited evidence either contradicts or does not support the key premises. E1 shows Al has a minor effect on oxidation in a different alloy at 400 °C, undermining the claim about Al/Ti-limited protection. E3 actually reports that ultrafine-grain (high grain boundary density) samples exhibit decelerated oxidation kinetics and enhanced resistance, directly opposing the premise that more grain boundaries accelerate degradation. E2 and E5 do not address the specific alloy or the proposed FCC-to-BCC transformation mechanism.
premises: Oxygen ingress along grain boundaries is the dominant degradation pathway
